The Lord kept his promise. Sarah bore Abraham a son in his old age, at the time God had set.
Sarah said: God has made me laugh, and all who hear will laugh with me.
When Isaac was weaned, Sarah saw Ishmael playing with him and said: send Hagar and her son away.
Abraham was deeply troubled, but God said: do not worry. I will make a nation of Ishmael too.
Early next morning, Abraham gave Hagar bread and water, and sent her away with the boy.
In the wilderness the water ran out, and she wept, unable to watch her son die.
But God heard the boy crying. The angel called from heaven: Hagar, do not be afraid.
God opened her eyes. She saw a well, and gave the boy a drink.
God was with the boy as he grew up.
God kept his promise to Sarah, in his own time.
And in the same chapter, he heard a thirsty boy crying in the wilderness.
God keeps his promises, and he hears the cries of the forgotten.
Today, wait with hope, and trust his timing.
What promise of God are you still waiting on?
